policy.basis: Initial companion ceilings use measured production bytes with floor(1.02 × JS) and floor(1.04 × CSS), following repository review limits; assets have no allowance. Gzip is summed per independently transferred file. Only these two exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary; eager-loading limits, all other passing metrics and external dependency inventories remain unchanged. The select consumed-key fix and shared tree size styles add 31 raw lazy bytes to the preceding prepared build.
